summary: LinuxCNC is a software controller designed to operate computer numerical control machines directly from a computer running a Linux operating system. It provides real-time control signals to drive hardware such as milling machines, lathes, 3D printers, and robotic arms.
goodFor: It is suited for workshops, makers, and engineers looking to build or retrofit physical manufacturing hardware using open-source control software.
watchOut: You need compatible computer hardware capable of meeting strict real-time kernel requirements, as standard desktop installations will cause timing jitter and machine failure.
deployNotes: It is typically distributed as native packages for Debian-based systems and requires direct hardware access rather than standard containerised deployment.
